{{Top|leg}}
A '''Neural-Net eraser''' was a device used throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], as protection against rogue [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. These devices became a necessity for many beings who feared they would be attacked by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. When fired, it released a streak of blue energy that would destroy a droids internal circuitry and software, rendering them useless.

The servant droid [[Solis]] was shot by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] with a Neural-Net eraser, causing him to spasm and go out of control.
